items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: It would be six or seven pieces that were during my father's time and I was playing with my father or something like that.

ctx.x: Oh yes, it would be bigger.

It would be six or seven pieces that were during my father's time and I was playing with my father or something like that. And my father would play real music or maybe you would call a hillbilly today because lots of them would get out there and do the card trill. Well that's the type of thing. Yeah, and they would do our, let me see. And they'd do a whole lot of clapping and keeping time with the music. Well I would say a card trill. I would say they would do a card trill dance during those times.
You understand what I'm speaking about? Yes, I've seen some of that.
